metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the shop, the upstairs book, Verona closed, and the heading Of Kings.

yesterday: Field lent the second volume. He will see the gap on the shelf every morning until it is back.
You read four columns standing. A king, his uncles, a cousin banished, a crown handed across.
The Verona page is closed. The new heading is Of Kings. The heralds were copied.
Tomorrow Hobbins is at the Bell, and Edith is to be paid from the stock.
